notes: 复用 owner login.py 的随机 loopback state 校验；WORKTIME_TOKEN 使用服务原生 wktok_ Bearer，不是飞书 access token。所有写操作沿用原 Skill 预览及新的顶层用户确认门禁。源码发现不激活 delegated provider。

identityProbe.rule: 身份来自 Feishu user_info 或 token 创建时保存的身份快照，不自动刷新。必须 cookie-free 校验 Bearer 并私下绑定身份；已有 session.user_info 优先，混合 cookie/Bearer 请求不能证明 Bearer subject。

tokenLifecycle.mechanism: wktok_ prefix; 32 random bytes; only SHA256 hash stored server-side
tokenLifecycle.expiry: Default 90 days, clamped 1–365 days; checked on each verification; no refresh route found.
tokenLifecycle.revoke: Matching current user_id is required; deleting the token record causes subsequent cookie-free verification to fail.
tokenLifecycle.limitation: Creation accepts user_id or open_id, but list/revoke and 10-token-per-user cap use user_id; open_id-only lifecycle remains unvalidated.
tokenLifecycle.logout: /auth/logout clears the browser Flask session only and does not revoke CLI tokens.

loginCapture: /auth/cli-redirect issues a 90-day token to exact http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback with state. Keep owner-native random-state loopback login; capture privately and suppress callback URL/query/token logs. No broad browser-cache harvesting.
permission: /api/worktime/check-permission resolves open_id and enabled departments; project membership and DELETE_ADMIN_OPEN_IDS are separate resource/write checks. Identity does not prove current permission.
credentialHandling: No login, secret reads, token issuance, or SaaS business calls performed. Raw tokens never enter chat, SSOT, repository or fixtures; private owner credential storage only.
deploymentConsistency: Research SHA is not a deployed SHA; effective deployment/auth configuration and cookie-free identity fixtures remain pending. Current Node/local documentation validation is not online verification.
referenceBase: owner-skill-root for SKILL.md/contractEntrypoints/referenceSources paths; contract field resolves from this JSON directory; upstream repository entrypoints stay repository-relative
